factory_init_called.meaning: the factory's deployBuilder() call invoked init(legitimateAdmin) on the deployed BuilderWallet

builder_admin_set.meaning: BuilderWallet.builderAdmin is already set (non-zero) at the time init() is invoked

reinit_allowed.meaning: BuilderWallet.init() completes successfully (re-initialization is permitted) while builderAdmin is already set

legitimate_admin_locked_out.meaning: the legitimate admin can no longer access the funds (potential lock-out)

assumptions: The factory's deployBuilder() call to init(legitimateAdmin) sets builderAdmin before any attacker init() call.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the attacker's init() overwrites an existing builderAdmin or whether init() was already called by the factory; the guard is formalized as 'init must not complete when builderAdmin is already set'.
The lock-out impact is potential and the report gives no concrete balance or access-check observable; V is bound to the report-stated lock-out outcome rather than a numeric quantity.

limitations: The impact is potential; the plan encodes the report-supported conditional scenario, not an inevitable lock-out.
The exact access-control guard (onlyFactory vs constructor-set admin) is not fixed by the report; the guard is expressed as builderAdmin already set.
No concrete fund balance is bound; the lock-out is a qualitative observable.
